findings.message: voterKey() is hidden, but leaves the same tag every time. `voters` insert receives persistentHash(… voterKey() …). It cannot be reversed, but the same input always gives the same value, so every call that publishes it can be linked to the same holder. The same tag appears in `register`, `vote`, so those transactions can be tied to one person.
